description: Two independent open hi-hat voices, each playing back one of 14 recorded samples, with a choke input that fades the sample away.

params.text: Chooses which of that voice's 14 samples plays, stepping between whole numbers from 0 to 13; 0 and 1 both give the first sample and the last of the 14 can never be reached.
Sets the playback rate of that voice's sample, from 0.2x to 1.8x of the recorded speed, which shifts its pitch and its length together.
Sets how long the choke fade takes to silence that voice, from 0.05 seconds to 0.5 seconds.

inputs.text: Adds to the SELECT knob at 1.4 samples per volt, with the total clamped between 0 and 14; a total of 14 or more gives the first sample instead.
Restarts that voice's sample from its first frame whenever the voltage rises through 0.5V.
Adds to the TUNE knob at 1x of playback rate per volt, with the total clamped between 0.2x and 1.8x.
Adds to the TIME knob at 0.049 seconds per volt, with the total clamped between 0.01 and 0.5 seconds; the manual's figure of 0.25 seconds per volt does not match the code.
Fades that voice's sample to silence over the TIME the knob sets, starting each time the voltage rises through 0.5V; a second rise during a fade returns the sample to full level first.

outputs.text: The audio of that voice's sample, played once through at the rate TUNE sets and then silent.

notes: a voice is only computed while there is a cable in its OUT jack, so with nothing patched there the gate input produces nothing.
the panel carries two voices with their own select, tune, gate and output; they run at the same time and share no controls.
a gate at GATE cancels any choke in progress and restarts the sample at full level.
